lines.ja: 勤務中にコタツで寝るなァ!!
lines.en: No napping in a kotatsu on the job!!

lines.ja: 地下は冷えるんだよォ〜
lines.en: The basement's freezing~

lines.ja: 二月。確定申告の季節。梨ヶ坂市役所・地下。
lines.en: February. Tax season. Nashigasaka City Hall, the basement.

lines.ja: おれのコタツ〜!!
lines.en: My kotatsu~!!

lines.ja: 上は二百人待ち。青色の農家さんが泣いてます
lines.en: 200 waiting upstairs. The blue-return farmers are in tears.
lines.note: A “blue return” (aoiro shinkoku) is Japan's bookkeeping-based tax return for sole proprietors and farmers. Keep proper books and you get a special deduction.

lines.ja: 公務員は年末調整。おれには関係ねえ!!
lines.en: Civil servants get year-end adjustment. Not my problem!!
lines.note: Year-end adjustment: for salaried workers, the employer settles the year's income tax, so most never file a return themselves.

lines.ja: 二月は、盆栽も剪定の季節ですねえ
lines.en: February is pruning season for bonsai, too.

lines.ja: 特務トレンド係から、申告会場に応援を一名!!
lines.en: The Special Trends Unit sends one helper to the tax desk!!

lines.ja: い、いまは係も手一杯で……
lines.en: W-well, the unit is rather swamped right now...

lines.ja: 二百人待ちだぞ!! 上は手が足りん!!
lines.en: Two hundred are waiting!! We're short-handed up there!!

lines.ja: ……承知いたしました
lines.en: ... Understood, sir.

lines.ja: 源田くん。コタツから出て、上へ
lines.en: Genda. Out of the kotatsu. Upstairs.

lines.ja: なんでおれェェ!?
lines.en: Why MEEE!?

lines.ja: 番号札配り……地獄だ……
lines.en: Handing out number tickets... this is hell...

lines.ja: 上の階。申告相談会場。
lines.en: Upstairs: the tax help desk.

lines.ja: 青色申告の方は、税務署へお願いします
lines.en: Blue returns go to the tax office, please.

lines.ja: 税務署は、隣の市じゃないか……
lines.en: But the tax office is in the next city...

lines.ja: 直売所のばあちゃん!?
lines.en: Granny from the farm stand!?

lines.ja: いつも試食だけ食べてく人!!
lines.en: The one who only eats the free samples!!

lines.ja: 案内する口実で、応援を抜けられる!!
lines.en: Show her the way, and I ditch helper duty!!

lines.ja: ばあちゃん、地下にデジタルの係がある!!
lines.en: Granny, there's a digital unit in the basement!!

lines.ja: 重っ!! 何が入ってんだ!?
lines.en: Heavy!! What's in this thing!?

lines.ja: テツ!! 応援はどうしたの!?
lines.en: Tetsu!! What happened to helping upstairs!?

lines.ja: 市民の案内だ!!
lines.en: I'm guiding a citizen!!

lines.ja: 梨農家のキヨだよ。四十年分の帳簿さ
lines.en: I'm Kiyo, pear farmer. Forty years of ledgers.

lines.ja: 複式簿記を、手書きで四十年……!?
lines.en: Double-entry, by hand, for forty years...!?

lines.ja: じいさんと二人で、つけてきたんだ
lines.en: Grandpa and I kept 'em together.

lines.ja: 死んで三年。帳簿だけは続けてる
lines.en: He's been gone three years. I still keep the books.

lines.ja: 来年から紙だと、十万しか引けないって……
lines.en: They say from next year, paper only gets 100,000 off...

lines.ja: いまは紙でも55万。来年から紙は10万!!
lines.en: Paper gets 550,000 now. From next year, just 100,000!!
lines.note: Real change: from tax year 2027, the blue-return deduction for paper filers drops from 550,000 yen to 100,000. Filing by e-Tax keeps 650,000 (750,000 with qualifying electronic books).

lines.ja: e-Taxで出せば、65万よ!!
lines.en: File by e-Tax and it's 650,000!!

lines.ja: 来年の申告（2027年分）から
lines.en: From next year's return (tax year 2027)

lines.ja: 差は45万!! 税金だけで年に七万近く!!
lines.en: That's 450,000!! Nearly 70,000 a year in tax alone!!

lines.ja: 今年e-Taxにすれば、＋10万です
lines.en: Switch to e-Tax this year: +100,000.

lines.ja: 来年からは、紙のままだと−45万
lines.en: Stay on paper from next year: -450,000.

lines.ja: 梨の箱で、十五箱ぶんかい……
lines.en: That's fifteen boxes of pears...

lines.ja: カードとスマホで、家から出せます!!
lines.en: With your card and a phone, you can file from home!!
lines.note: “Card” = the My Number card, Japan's ID card, which doubles as your digital signature for e-Tax.

lines.ja: 電話は、これだけさ
lines.en: This is the only phone I've got.

lines.ja: ……アプリが、入らない!!
lines.en: ...The app won't install!!

lines.ja: なら、税務署の会場へ!!
lines.en: Then the tax office's filing venue!!

lines.ja: バスは一日三本。坂を下りて一時間
lines.en: Three buses a day. An hour down the hill.

lines.ja: 税理士さんに頼むとか……
lines.en: Maybe ask a tax accountant...

lines.ja: 税理士さんなんて、高くて頼めないよ
lines.en: Tax accountants? Too pricey for me.

lines.ja: 正しいことを言っても、届かない……!!
lines.en: Being right just isn't reaching her...!!

lines.ja: 梨の仲間も、みんな紙なんだよ……
lines.en: My pear-farmer friends all file on paper too...

lines.ja: みんな……紙……!?
lines.en: All of them... paper...!?

lines.ja: e-Tax代行で、ひと山当てるぜェェ!!
lines.en: An e-Tax filing service! I'm gonna strike it RICH!!

lines.ja: 入力は、一件いくらの歩合で？
lines.en: My commission per entry?

lines.ja: 五百円だ!!
乗ります
lines.en: I'm in.

lines.ja: 公務員が市民からお金を取るなァ!!
lines.en: Civil servants don't take money from citizens!!

lines.ja: ……でも電子申告率が上がれば、本庁に……
lines.en: ...But if the e-filing rate goes up, the main building...

lines.ja: ばあちゃん、おれに任せな!!
lines.en: Granny, leave it to me!!

lines.ja: 今年は10万、来年は45万、守ってやらァ!!
lines.en: 100,000 this year, 450,000 next - I'll protect it!!

lines.ja: あんた、試食だけの人じゃなかったんだねえ
lines.en: You're not just the free-sample guy after all.

lines.ja: 顔と背中で、別人ですね
lines.en: Front and back, he's two different people.

lines.ja: 借方!! 貸方!! 左右は必ず同じ金額!!
lines.en: Debit!! Credit!! Both sides always match!!

lines.ja: ――その夜。
lines.en: —That night.

lines.ja: 優良な電子帳簿……金ピカか!?
lines.en: "Superior" electronic books... solid gold!?
lines.note: Real term: “yūryō denshi chōbo” (superior electronic books) are digital books that keep a record of every correction and can be searched by date, amount and client. Nothing to do with gold.

lines.ja: 訂正や削除の跡が、残る帳簿だ!!
lines.en: Books that keep a trail of every fix and deletion!!

lines.ja: 日付・金額・取引先で探せる!!
lines.en: Searchable by date, amount and client!!

lines.ja: e-Taxは、本人のカードと暗証番号で送る!!
lines.en: e-Tax gets sent with your OWN card and PIN!!

lines.ja: ……見えてきたぜ……!!
lines.en: ...I'm starting to see it...!!

lines.ja: ――見えたァ!! 来年から、紙は十万!!
lines.en: —I SEE IT!! From next year, paper gets 100,000!!

lines.ja: e-Taxで65万、電子帳簿も優良なら75万!!
lines.en: e-Tax gets 650,000. With superior e-books, 750,000!!

lines.ja: 税理士にしかできねえ仕事ってのは……
lines.en: The work only a tax accountant can do...

lines.ja: 帳簿付けの代行は、税理士じゃなくてもできる!!
lines.en: Keeping books for others doesn't need a tax accountant!!
lines.note: Real rule: bookkeeping for others is open to anyone. Preparing someone else's tax return is not.

lines.ja: 申告書なんざ、帳簿の数字を写すだけ!!
lines.en: A tax return just copies numbers from the books!!

lines.ja: 帳簿の続きだ!! 全部おれにできる!!
lines.en: It's the books, continued!! I can do it ALL!!

lines.ja: いまは剪定の季節でねえ
lines.en: It's pruning season right now.

lines.ja: テツさん、二月にビーチサンダルですか
lines.en: Tetsu, beach sandals in February?

lines.ja: 放課後。冬の梨畑。
lines.en: After school. A pear orchard in winter.

lines.ja: 寒くねえ!! 金の匂いで温まってる!!
lines.en: Not cold!! The smell of money keeps me warm!!

lines.ja: 一件五百円……一件五百円……!!
lines.en: 500 yen a case... 500 yen a case...!!

lines.ja: 肥料、農薬、段ボール……じいさん細けえな!!
lines.en: Fertilizer, pesticide, cardboard... fussy old man!!

lines.ja: じいさん……こんなとこに……
lines.en: Grandpa... here, of all places...
lines.note: The pencil note in the ledger reads: “Kiyo — please keep next year's books too.”

lines.ja: ち、ちくしょう、目にゴミが……!!
lines.en: D-dammit, something's in my eye...!!

lines.ja: じいさんの字が、画面に並んでる……
lines.en: Grandpa's handwriting, there on the screen...

lines.ja: 泣きながら請求書を書かないでください
lines.en: Please don't write invoices while crying.

lines.ja: それとこれとは別だ!!
lines.en: That's a separate matter!!

lines.ja: うちの帳簿も頼む!!
lines.en: Do our books too!!

lines.ja: 毎度ありィィ!!
lines.en: Much obliiiged!!

lines.ja: テツさん、公務員の副業って……
lines.en: Tetsu, civil servants with side jobs...

lines.ja: バレなきゃ仕様だ!!
lines.en: If nobody finds out, it's a feature!!

lines.ja: 一週間で、依頼は三十軒。
lines.en: In one week: thirty clients.

lines.ja: 梨ジュースでも、受け付けまァす!!
lines.en: Pear juice accepted as payment!!

lines.ja: ついでに、申告書も作ってくれんかね
lines.en: Could you do our tax returns while you're at it?

lines.ja: 申告書……帳簿の、続きだ……!!
lines.en: Tax returns ... just the books, continued ...!!

lines.ja: 帳簿の続きで、申告書も作ってやらァ!!
lines.en: The books continue - I'll do your tax returns too!!

lines.ja: おまかせで、全員65万だ!!
lines.en: Full service! 650,000 for EVERYONE!!

lines.ja: 3万!? しかも保証って、さすがに……
lines.en: 30,000 yen!? And a guarantee? That's going too far...

lines.ja: 赤嶺、この数字が本庁に届くんだぜ
lines.en: Akamine, these numbers go straight to the main building.
... The main building ...

lines.ja: それ、本当に帳簿の続きですか？
lines.en: Is that really just the books, continued?

lines.ja: 数字を写すだけだ!!
lines.en: It's just copying numbers!!

lines.ja: 小僧、今夜は徹夜で入力だ!!
lines.en: Kid, we're doing data entry all night!!

lines.ja: 18歳未満の深夜労働は禁止!! 労基法61条!!
lines.en: No late-night work for under-18s!! Labor Standards Act, Art. 61!!

lines.ja: 今週は、みなさん熱心ですねえ
lines.en: Everyone's so diligent this week.

lines.ja: 土曜は梨ヶ坂じゅうの申告を、おれが出す!!
lines.en: Saturday, I file for the WHOLE town!!

lines.ja: ――隣のポスターに、誰も気づかなかった。
lines.en: —Nobody noticed the poster right next to it.

lines.ja: じいさん、土曜に出してもらうからね
lines.en: Grandpa, they'll file for us on Saturday.

lines.ja: さあ、どんどん送るぞォ!!
lines.en: Alright, let's send 'em all!!

lines.ja: 土曜日。梨ヶ坂公民館。
lines.en: Saturday. Nashigasaka Community Center.

lines.ja: 暗証番号は、ご自分で!! 見てませんから!!
lines.en: Enter your PIN yourself!! I'm not looking!!

lines.ja: そこだけは、ちゃんとしてるんですね
lines.en: So that part, you do properly.

lines.ja: ……代わりに、作ります？
lines.en: ...Preparing them on their behalf?
lines.note: She's reading Tetsu's banner: “Tax returns — we'll prepare them for you.”

lines.ja: 次は、あたしの番だね
lines.en: My turn next.

lines.ja: 税理士でない方が、他人の申告書を作るのは……
lines.en: If you're not a tax accountant, preparing other people's returns...

lines.ja: タダでもダメです!! 税理士法52条!!
lines.en: Illegal, even for free!! Tax Accountant Act, Art. 52!!
lines.note: Real law: in Japan, preparing tax returns or giving tax advice for others is reserved for licensed tax accountants (zeirishi), paid or not.

lines.ja: ちょ、帳簿の続きじゃ……
lines.en: B-but it's just the books, continued...

lines.ja: 帳簿付けは誰でもできます。申告書は、別です
lines.en: Anyone can keep books. Tax returns are different.

lines.ja: それに、この簡単な帳簿では
lines.en: Besides, with simple books like these,

lines.ja: e-Taxでも65万には、なりません
lines.en: even e-Tax won't get you 650,000.
lines.note: The 650,000 and 750,000 deductions require double-entry bookkeeping. With simple books, it's 100,000 even on e-Tax.

lines.ja: ほ、保証がァァ!!
lines.en: M-my guarantee!!

lines.ja: タダ!? あっちは無料なのかい!?
lines.en: Free!? That one's FREE!?

lines.ja: ま、待ってくれェェ!!
lines.en: W-wait for meeee!!

lines.ja: わ、私の実績がァァ!!
lines.en: M-my record!!

lines.ja: あたしの申告、ダメになるのかい……
lines.en: Is my tax return ruined now...

lines.ja: 僕の歩合も、流れていきました
lines.en: My commission floated away too.

lines.ja: 当市の職員が、申告書を……三万円で……
lines.en: One of our staff... prepared returns... for 30,000 yen...

lines.ja: 税理士会から、市役所に丁寧な電話が入った。
lines.en: The tax accountants' association made a very polite call to City Hall.

lines.ja: 大変、申し訳ございません
lines.en: We are deeply, deeply sorry.

lines.ja: 送信の前で、よかったです
lines.en: Good thing nothing was sent yet.

lines.ja: 源田さん。
lines.en: Mr. Genda.

lines.ja: 「さん」に、なった……!!
lines.en: He called me "Mister"...!!

lines.ja: 三月十五日まで毎日、ご案内をお願いします
lines.en: Please guide visitors here every day until March 15.
lines.note: The sign reads: “Tax returns: see a tax accountant. Free consultations this way →”

lines.ja: お代と梨ジュースは、全額お返しに
lines.en: Refund every fee and every bottle of pear juice.

lines.ja: 公務員の副業は、許可が要ります
lines.en: Civil servants need permission for side jobs.
lines.note: Real law: Japan's Local Public Service Act requires permission before a civil servant takes paid side work.

lines.ja: 無料相談は、こちらァァ!!
lines.en: Free consultations, THIS WAAAY!!

lines.ja: 来年もこの公民館で、相談会を!!
lines.en: Let's hold the clinic here again next year!!

lines.ja: 三月。梨ヶ坂公民館。
lines.en: March. The community center.

lines.ja: 押したら、出たよォ!!
lines.en: I pushed it, and off it went!!

lines.ja: じいさん、今年の帳簿も出したよ
lines.en: Grandpa, I filed this year's books too.

lines.ja: 来年も案内を。もちろん、無償で
lines.en: Guide again next year, please. Unpaid, of course.

lines.ja: タダ働きかよォォ!!
lines.en: Working for FREE!?

lines.ja: 紙だと十万。テツさんは、ゼロですね
lines.en: On paper, a hundred thousand. Tetsu gets zero.
